scoring_rules: Physical original with source species and usable rights must show structure at enough resolution for role 1; partial visibility=0.5; absent/different taxon=0. Photos not descriptions. 75%=4.5/6; 70% target implies at least 4.5 given half-point increments.
phase_priority: Every assigned species >=70% before 80-85%, then 90%; aboveground TRUE inner ligule/collar > reproductive macros > whole flowering habit > root base > native/exotic lookalike. Never stall one species for rare photo.
